transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Hello. I keep getting stuck on these ideas that people around me are plotting or judging me, even when they swear they aren’t. Things have gotten really stressful lately, so my wife, our pastor, and my regular doctor all suggested I should come in and talk to someone.
How long have you been having these beliefs that people are plotting or judging you, and have you ever had other symptoms like hearing voices or feeling that your thoughts were being controlled?

The feeling that people are plotting against me has been going on since late last fall. I also hear a man's voice every so often, especially when I'm alone or working late in the garage, commenting on what I'm doing. But I don't feel like anyone is controlling my thoughts.
Have these beliefs and the voice been present continuously for more than one month, or did they come on suddenly and change a lot over a short period of days or weeks?
They've definitely been there for much longer than a month. They didn't just appear out of nowhere and change over a few days; they've been hanging around pretty consistently since late last fall.
Have you ever had a period of at least a few days where your mood was very high or very irritable, you needed much less sleep, or your thoughts raced unusually fast?

Yes, I've had periods like that coming and going for close to a year now. I'll get so wired that I only sleep three or four hours a night with my mind racing about work and baby plans, and my mood swings from feeling on top of the world to snapping at my wife or coworkers over minor things.
Have you had a stretch of at least 2 weeks when the hallucinations or paranoid beliefs continued even when your mood was not unusually high, irritable, or depressed?

Yes, that actually happened this past spring. My mood had mostly flattened out and I wasn't especially up or down, but for a few weeks I still kept hearing that man's voice and felt sure people at work were plotting against me.
Have you ever had at least 2 weeks when you were hearing the voice or feeling paranoid while your mood was completely normal and you were not having any manic or depressive symptoms?

Yes, that's what happened this past spring. My mood had mostly flattened out and I wasn't feeling up or down, but for a few weeks I still kept hearing that man's voice and felt convinced people at work were plotting against me.
Have you also had periods of depression, like feeling very down, losing interest, or having low energy, that lasted for at least 2 weeks?

I do get these phases where I lose all my drive and interest, though I'm not sure if it's official depression. On those days, I just sit on the couch staring at the TV, neglecting my car projects, and my wife has to push me just to shower or answer texts. It's like a major loss of energy and motivation that can last for weeks.
Have those low mood or loss-of-interest periods lasted for at least 2 weeks at a time, with symptoms like feeling down, losing pleasure, low energy, or trouble concentrating?

I haven't really experienced prolonged periods of feeling deeply down or depressed like that. I definitely have those days where I completely lose interest and just sit on the couch, but I wouldn't say I feel deeply sad or depressed for weeks at a time.

Have you ever had a clear manic episode that lasted at least 1 week, or a major depressive episode that lasted at least 2 weeks, with the hallucinations or paranoia happening only during those mood episodes?

No, they didn't happen only during those high-energy phases. Like I mentioned, this past spring when my mood had flattened out and I felt pretty normal, I still heard the voice and felt like people were plotting against me for a few weeks.
Have these mood episodes and the hallucinations/paranoid beliefs been present for at least 6 months overall, with ongoing problems in work, relationships, or self-care during that time?

Yes, this has been going on for over a year now, and it has seriously disrupted my life. My supervisor cut my responsibilities at the shop after we argued, my wife and I fight constantly, and I've stopped going to my car club. I also struggle with basic things at home like bills, cleaning, and even showering unless my wife pushes me to do it.

Have you ever used alcohol, cannabis, stimulants, or other drugs heavily around the time these symptoms started, or do you have any history of a brain injury or a family history of schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, or schizoaffective disorder?

No, I don't have a history of heavy drug or alcohol use, and I've never had a major brain injury. I'm also not aware of any family history of schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, or schizoaffective disorder.
